pairs.subject: concurrent-vcs
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/claude_cli.rs:213 The engine starts every Claude/codex/agy process in an isolated work_dir that defaults to a temp directory (config.rs:201), runs codex with a read-only sandbox, and never stages, commits, stashes or creates worktrees; a case-insensitive search of crates/shadowrunr-engine for worktree, stash, GIT_INDEX_FILE and 'git commit' found nothing, so the subject's precondition (sessions sharing one repo checkout and committing to it) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/config.rs:201 Spawned CLIs run in a temp work dir, not a repo checkout, so there is no tree to isolate with a worktree.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/alt_cli.rs:65 codex runs with --sandbox read-only, and nothing in the context builds a commit, so it never touches a staging index.

crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/claude_cli.rs:186 The one shared scratch resource (the prompts dir) is written through a temp file named per process, then atomically renamed into a content-addressed path. That is the namespacing the technique asks for, even though no VCS is involved.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/fleet.rs:358 Alt CLIs also start in the non-repo work_dir. The context has no commit path and no hook to guard.
